purpose: Offline adequacy diagnosis only; no hardware command, parameter tuning or candidate release
features: Own prior encoder-derived modal velocity, recorded input with fixed lag, own half-skew, tanh own velocity. No measured RPM feature.
initialization: Measured position and past velocity once at50ms; after this no measured states in forced rollout
validation: Train S3R2/test BLNN, then reverse; retain all16 branches. No selection of best branch to declare plant identified.
divergence: Stop only on nonfinite state or absolute predicted displacement exceeding1m. Preserve failed branch and actual/predicted step counts. This is a numerical stop, not a motor safety threshold.
limitations: One diagnostic trajectory per method; closed-loop correlations,10ms decimation and uncalibrated counts cannot alone establish counterfactual plant validity or identify a causal implementation defect. No automatic physical release.
